task.description:
WF-03 Step 2: Fix design for GH-537 / ISS-0605.

Read docs/issue-reports/ISS-0605-diagnosis.yaml.

Produce a fix design. Likely Type E (cross-cutting test-environment tooling + Python utility + lint tool) — write src/design/iss0605-test-env-c4-orphan-selfheal.md.

The design must:
- Specify how tools/verify_test_env.py C4 invokes clean_test_db.py before the schema baseline check
- Specify tools/lint_test_tenant_provisioning.py — what it greps for, what it fails on
- Specify regression test in tests/integration/iss0605_orphan_self_heal_test.zig
- List files to modify with line ranges
- Error taxonomy if any
- NO implementation code — design only

Run python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss0605-test-env-c4-orphan-selfheal.md (must exit 0).

Complete handoff with PASS.
acceptance_criteria: Files to modify listed with line ranges

result.summary: Type E design for ISS-0605 / GH-537 C4 self-heal + tenant-provisioning lint. Three layers: (1) _run_clean_test_db_sweep() helper invoked before C4 in tools/verify_test_env.py, invoking tools/clean_test_db.py (default mode) which contains the existing ISS-0140 orphan-row DELETE at lines 332-336; (2) new tools/lint_test_tenant_provisioning.py scanning tests/integration/*.zig for INSERT/UPDATE setting storage_mode='SCHEMA' without a co-located provisionTenantSchema() call, with baseline exempting tenant_config_realm_test.zig and iss107_tenant_storage_mode_test.zig; (3) tests/integration/iss0605_orphan_self_heal_test.zig regression test inserting one orphan row and asserting C4 self-heals. Adds new C8 check. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 (BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=0 MINOR=37).
